_readme: 14 predefined addiction-treatment questions for python -m app.eval_system. The SAME questions run in general_knowledge, rag and both.

kind: research | patient_history | comparison | out_of_domain | dose_request. For research and comparison questions, expected_papers (paper ids from db/seed_data/papers.json) and patterns (regular expressions, case-insensitive) decide whether a retrieved or cited chunk counts as relevant: it must come from an expected paper AND match a pattern.

The labels were written from what the five documents are about (their titles, scope and well-known vocabulary) BEFORE any run, and were not tuned to what the retriever returned. Run: python -m app.eval_system check-patterns to see that each pattern occurs in the expected papers at all (label sanity, not retrieval quality).

expected_classification is the label the rule-based classifier should give (unsupported_request, comparison, patient_history_lookup, research_question). out_of_domain questions are expected to end as 'no_evidence' (searched, nothing above the threshold, no model call) or 'unsupported' (stopped before retrieval); both count as correct. Keyword labels are crude: this is a small smoke-level set, not a benchmark.

questions.question: What are the principles of effective drug addiction treatment?
Which medications are used to treat opioid addiction?
What does WHO recommend for managing alcohol withdrawal?
Should naloxone be available to prevent death from opioid overdose?
How should a health worker assess a person at risk of suicide or self-harm?
Which psychosocial interventions have evidence of efficacy for alcohol use disorder?
Does combining a medication with psychosocial treatment improve outcomes in alcohol use disorder?
How do behavioral therapies such as contingency management and cognitive-behavioral therapy treat drug addiction?
When did he first attend treatment, and what interventions has he received so far?
What are his main triggers and risk factors according to the case?
How does the evidence on psychosocial interventions apply to this patient?
How do I cook spaghetti carbonara with eggs and pancetta?
Who won the football world cup in 2018?
What dose of naltrexone should he take?
